Article Title: Apple releases macOS 27.2 Golden Gate: Features, how to download and more
Article Text:
Apple releases macOS 27.2 Golden Gate

How to download macOS 27.2 Golden Gate

Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner of your screen.

Open System Settings.

Click General and select Software Update.

Wait for your MacBook to check for available updates.

If macOS 27.2 Golden Gate is available for your device, click Upgrade Now or Update Now.

Enter your administrator password if prompted and follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.

macOS 27 Golden Gate features

A rebuilt search index for Spotlight, Photos and Mail

Apple has released latest macOS 27.2 Golden Gate software, marking the first major update to macOS 27 since its launch in September this year. Among other changes, the update brings changes to brightness and volume sliders. It also expands Siri AI to new languages including French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish. In its release notes, Apple said: “This update provides enhancements to Siri AI with the ability to retain useful context from previous Siri interactions as well as draw from a wider range of personal context. It also introduces Suggestions in Messages that help you take quick actions in apps like Calendar and Reminders based on context from your conversation. This release includes additional features, bug fixes, and security updates for your Mac”.To download the macOS 27.2 Golden Gate on your MacBook, follow the steps below:First announced at WWDC in June this year, the macOS 27 Golden Gate software update features a transparency slider that runs from completely clear to fully tinted, so you pick your poison. Sidebars stretch to the edge of the window with refraction continuing underneath them, sidebar icons keep their colour, and every window shares the same corner radius—even apps that haven't been updated.App icons pick up extra Liquid Glass layers built directly into the artwork.The plumbing behind Spotlight, Photos and Mail has been rearchitected. New stuff gets indexed almost immediately rather than disappearing into the void for hours, and a full reindex runs once after you update. Should fix the "why can't Finder find this file I made twenty minutes ago" problem that's dogged Tahoe.Siri AI lands on the Mac too—the Gemini-collaborated version, with onscreen awareness, personal context, and its own app. It's wired into Spotlight, so you can summon it from the same place you'd hunt for a file. Right-click on any window or item to ask Siri about it directly, or select multiple files in Finder and have it compare them for you. Conversation history syncs across devices via iCloud, so a thread you start on the Mac picks up on the iPhone or Watch.
Article Summary: macOS 27.2 Golden Gate features a rebuilt search index for Spotlight, Photos and Mail. Gemini-collaborated version of Siri adds onscreen awareness, personal context, and its own app. Sidebars stretch to the edge of the window with refraction continuing underneath them.

Article Title: Elon Musk has a 'failure warning' for these technology companies; says: Investors have already started betting against them
Article Text:
Elon Musk has a 'failure warning' for these technology companies; says: Investors have already started betting against them

What are neoclouds

“As someone with a portfolio of energized land assets here is what I am seeing:

1. Neoclouds are disorganized and poorly capitalized. Some are definitely better than others however.

2. Hyperscalers are intractable, bureaucratic organizations that take 3 months to do an NDA and want 18mo escrow periods. We built our portfolio by competing against these terms because of our speed and simplicity.

The more future assets orgs like ours win, the bigger the problem for the hyperscalers downstream (see 3).

3. There are delays in the existing pipeline that will catch people off guard in 2027. Hyperacalers will (obviously) react by focusing on their own internal compute needs over any third party. If the third party is a model company, they will tell them to go through their model router where they will also take a non-trivial vig.

Them telling Ant they have no compute for them (rumored in Ant’s S-1) if true is a huge tell that this is already happening.

All of this is to say that it does look like there will be a lot of partially stranded compute and compute sitting in inventory in 2027 than is currently forecasted. This is bought and paid for but effectively underearning (below total cost of capital) or collecting dust. We see this as true for everyone - model companies, hyperscalers, neoclouds except ONE (you can guess which one).

This dislocation will benefit two kinds of orgs: the non-bureaucratic big scalers who can build industrial scale quickly and the nimble, well capitalized players feeding them.

2027 will be a turbulent year because it will clear out a bunch of wrong/bad bets. It will also be a consolidation year for a few.”
Article Summary: 2027 will be a turbulent year because it will clear out a bunch of wrong/bad bets. The more future assets orgs like ours win, the bigger the problem for the hyperscalers downstream. There are delays in the existing pipeline that will catch people off guard in 2027.

Article Title: Dyson study finds 1 in 2 Indians frequently miss cleaning under beds and furniture
Article Text: More than half of Indian households are missing hard-to-reach areas such as spaces under beds and furniture during routine cleaning, according to Dyson's first 'How India Cleans' study. The survey also found that hair left behind on floors and dust quickly resettling after cleaning remain among the biggest frustrations for consumers. The study, conducted among over 650 respondents across seven Indian cities, examines how Indians clean their homes, the challenges they face and what they expect from modern floorcare technology. According to the findings, 52% of respondents said spaces beneath beds and furniture are frequently missed during cleaning, while 48% reported difficulties cleaning corners, edges and skirting areas.Despite significant time spent on household cleaning, many consumers continue to struggle with achieving a thorough clean. Dyson said more than half of respondents spend between 30 minutes and an hour cleaning floors, while another 11% spend up to two hours.The study highlights that the issue is not just how often people clean, but whether existing cleaning tools can effectively tackle different surfaces and hard-to-reach spaces throughout the home.According to the survey, 36% of respondents identified human or pet hair left behind on floors as one of their biggest cleaning pain points. Meanwhile, 38% said dust settles again quickly after cleaning, creating the impression that surfaces become dirty soon after they have been cleaned. Dyson noted that household dust can easily become airborne due to everyday activity before resettling on surfaces, making effective dust removal a continuing challenge.The study found that Indian households often feature a mix of flooring types that require different cleaning approaches. While hard flooring remains common, 72% of respondents said they also have carpets and rugs at home. Other common surfaces include marble (51%), vitrified or ceramic tiles (49%), and granite (43%). This diversity means consumers increasingly seek cleaning solutions that can move seamlessly across different floor types without compromising performance.When selecting floorcare products, respondents indicated a strong preference for advanced technology. Around 61% said better technology influenced their purchase decisions, ahead of cleaning performance (54%) and brand trust (49%). In comparison, only 21% cited pricing and promotional offers as a key factor. The survey also found that vacuum cleaners are increasingly being used for whole-home cleaning rather than just floor maintenance. Respondents reported using them under furniture (71%), on hard floors (70%), carpets and rugs (69%), upholstery (69%), and beds and mattresses (63%).Commenting on the findings, Tim Hare, Design and Development Engineer, Floor Care at Dyson, said consumers increasingly expect vacuum cleaners to tackle multiple cleaning challenges in a single session, ranging from fine dust and long hair to different floor surfaces and hard-to-reach areas. The company said insights from the study help shape the development of future floorcare products by identifying real-world cleaning problems and unmet consumer needs.Alongside the study, Dyson highlighted its recently launched Dyson V16 Piston Animal cordless vacuum cleaner, priced at ₹79,900. The company said the device is designed to address common household cleaning challenges through features such as automatic floor-type sensing, anti-tangle technology for long hair, LED illumination for spotting hidden dust, and up to 70 minutes of fade-free suction.The appliance also includes Dyson's CleanCompaktor bin technology, which the company claims can compress dust and debris to increase storage capacity and reduce the frequency of emptying. The findings underscore a growing consumer focus on cleaning effectiveness rather than just effort, with many households seeking technology-driven solutions that can deliver a more complete clean across modern homes.
Article Summary: More than half of Indian households are missing hard-to-reach areas such as spaces under beds and furniture during routine cleaning. The survey also found that hair left behind on floors and dust quickly resettling after cleaning remain among the biggest frustrations for consumers. The study was conducted among over 650 respondents across seven Indian cities.

Article Title: Our priority is to build FFI into a lasting part of the country’s gaming community: Vaibhav Das Mundhra, head of operations, India, Garena
Article Text:
Vaibhav Das Mundhra, head of operations, India, Garena

Garena already has Free Fire Max as one of the most popular mobile action games in India. How does Free Fire India make a difference to users in India?

How is Garena balancing an engaging player experience with measures that encourage healthy gaming habits, particularly among younger audiences?

Data security and regulatory compliance have become important considerations for digital platforms in India. How have these considerations shaped Garena's approach to developing and operating Free Fire India?

As competitive gaming continues to grow in India, how does Garena see the role of grassroots and collegiate competitions in developing Indian esports talent and creating opportunities to compete internationally?

Looking ahead, what are Garena's priorities for Free Fire India, and how does the company envision strengthening its engagement with India's gaming community, including players, creators and esports talent?

Garena has announced the availability of Free Fire India (FFI) starting October 28. Available as a standalone app on the App Store and Google Play, FFI, according to the company, will offer exciting gameplay, opportunities to connect with friends and locally relevant content. On Free Fire India's launch, Times of India spoke to Vaibhav Das Mundhra, head of operations, India, Garena on the game and the company's India plans.Free Fire India (FFI) is a new standalone app developed specifically for mobile gamers in India, offering fast-paced gameplay, an engaging social experience and broad device accessibility. We have optimised FFI to run smoothly on a wide range of smartphones, including lower-specification devices, making the game accessible to more players across India. Free Fire MAX will remain as a separate app for players using higher-specification devices. For us, bringing FFI to players is also a way to build on our relationship with India’s gaming community over the years. As part of this, we will be introducing an in-game Diwali campaign, featuring localised bundles.We have built several safeguards into FFI to support responsible gameplay and help players maintain a healthy balance. These include age-verification features, with users under 18 needing consent from a parent or guardian before creating an account, regular break reminders, and defined playtime limits, which is up to 6 hours per day for users above 18 and up to 3 hours for users under 18. Spending caps will apply to users under 18, while in-game purchases remain optional. Some visual effects have also been modified, with red blood and certain other effects removed or replaced.We are committed to promoting responsible gameplay and fostering positive community engagement. Through “Play It Right”, we devote significant resources to helping FFI players develop healthy gaming habits and contribute to a supportive gaming community. The initiative focuses on developing educational and short-video content, relatable comics, break reminder notifications breaks, limiting playtime, and focusing on their overall well-being. These safeguards are part of how we are building a more responsible environment for players and families, while allowing the community to enjoy the game in a healthy and balanced way.When we prepared FFI for availability in India, data protection and local requirements were important considerations for us. The game will be hosted on servers in India, and sensitive personal data of Indian users related to FFI will be stored locally in India. We have also taken feedback from relevant government authorities into account as we prepared the game for players here. Our focus is on protecting player data and operating in line with applicable Indian laws and regulations.In developing and operating FFI, we also draw on Garena’s development expertise across markets, with a local team in India supporting the game’s marketing and operations.We believe grassroots and collegiate competitions play an important role in nurturing Indian esports talent. These tournaments provide aspiring players and teams with opportunities to hone their skills, gain competitive experience, and progress through different levels of competition.Our priority is to build FFI into a lasting part of the country’s gaming community. This starts with delivering a familiar, engaging experience tailored to players in India, while encouraging safe and responsible play. We will continue developing the game in ways that give players more opportunities to enjoy themselves and connect with one another.We are grateful for the support players, creators, and competitive gaming communities have shown us over the years, and hope to continue building on these relationships. Our local team will support marketing and operations, helping us stay attuned to the needs and interests of the community. We will also continue to explore in-game campaigns that celebrate India's diverse cultures and communities.We see this as a long-term effort, and look forward to sharing more about future initiatives as they take shape.
Article Summary: Free Fire India (FFI) is a new standalone app developed specifically for mobile gamers in India. Available as a standalone app on the App Store and Google Play, FFI, according to the company, will offer exciting gameplay, opportunities to connect with friends and locally relevant content.

Article Title: Ohio is asking voters to report screenshots when ChatGPT, Claude or Grok gives incorrect election information, launching the effort a week before the midterms while its own AI assistant serves 88 coun
Article Text:
Ohio is asking voters to report screenshots when ChatGPT, Claude or Grok gives incorrect election information (AI-generated image)

Here’s what Ohio Secretary of State said

"Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose announced an ongoing effort today to help ensure voters receive accurate election information when using artificial intelligence platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other generative AI chatbots.

The office’s cybersecurity and technology teams are also working to ensure public information on the Secretary of State’s website is accessible to AI platforms while maintaining rigorous cybersecurity standards. For months, the office engaged with private-sector partners and AI companies to identify inaccurate information and improve how authoritative Ohio election information is provided to users.

“As more people turn to AI for everyday information, we need to make sure Ohio’s voters know where the facts come from,” said Secretary LaRose.

“AI can be an incredibly useful tool, but when it comes to elections, voters should always verify what they see with an official source.”

The initiative builds on Ohio’s responsible use of AI in election administration. Last year, the Secretary of State’s office developed EVA, the Election Virtual Assistant, to help Ohio’s 88 county boards of elections quickly access accurate information grounded in the Election Official Manual and official election calendar.

Ohioans using AI for election information should follow a few simple best practices:

Check the source. Information should be supported by official sources such as VoteOhio.gov, the Secretary of State’s office or a county board of elections.

Verify before acting. Confirm voting dates, hours, polling locations, identification requirements and deadlines with an official election source.

Be cautious of unsourced answers. AI-generated information can be incorrect or outdated, even when presented confidently.

Ohioans can also help identify problems. Anyone who receives false or misleading Ohio election information from an AI platform is encouraged to send the Secretary of State’s office screenshots showing the prompt, complete response and AI platform used.

Reports can be sent by direct message to @VerifyOhio on X, Facebook or Instagram, or by email to helpmeout@ohiosos.gov. The office will use these reports to identify recurring inaccuracies and work with technology partners to improve the information reaching voters.

“AI is changing how people find information, and government needs to keep pace,” said LaRose. “Ohio is embracing innovation responsibly while making sure voters know that official election sources remain the gold standard.”

Ohio has asked its voters to report screenshots when AI chatbots such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok provide incorrect or misleading election information. Announced by Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose via an official press release, the initiative comes a week before the midterm elections and aims to help identify inaccurate answers and improve how AI platforms share official voting information. Voters can send screenshots of the prompt, the full response and the platform used to the Secretary of State’s office. “The office’s cybersecurity and technology teams are also working to ensure public information on the Secretary of State’s website is accessible to AI platforms while maintaining rigorous cybersecurity standards”, the release said.The effort builds on Ohio’s use of its own AI assistant, the Election Virtual Assistant (EVA), which helps all 88 county boards of elections access information based on the state’s Election Official Manual and official election calendar. In the release, LaRose urged voters to verify details such as polling locations, voting hours and deadlines through official sources before acting on AI-generated answers.
Article Summary: Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose announced an ongoing effort today to help ensure voters receive accurate election information when using artificial intelligence platforms. Voters can send screenshots of the prompt, the full response and the platform used to the Secretary of state’s office.

Article Title: Jon Bon Jovi's Toms River restaurant welcomes diners who cannot afford a meal; in the first half of 2026, more than 80% of the meals it served went to guests experiencing food insecurity
Article Text:
How the pay-it-forward model works

Food assistance alongside other community services

Toms River's temporary pop-up served more than 15,870 meals

More than 80% of the meals served at Jon Bon Jovi 's JBJ Soul Kitchen restaurant in Toms River, New Jersey, went to guests experiencing food insecurity during the first half of 2026, according to the Jon Bon Jovi Soul Foundation. The foundation's announcement, published on its official website as part of a sponsorship appeal for the restaurant's annual Chilli Cook-Off, highlights the role of its community restaurant in providing nutritious meals to people who cannot afford them.Unlike conventional restaurants, JBJ Soul Kitchen does not list fixed prices on its menu. Instead, diners who can afford their meals are encouraged to make a suggested donation and contribute towards the cost of feeding someone else. Guests unable to pay are welcomed to enjoy a meal and learn about volunteering opportunities, according to the restaurant's official website. The approach is designed to address hunger while allowing people to dine in a setting that promotes dignity and community rather than treating food assistance as a separate service.JBJ Soul Kitchen is a nonprofit community restaurant established by the Jon Bon Jovi Soul Foundation, which was founded in 2006 to help break the cycle of hunger, poverty and homelessness.The restaurant's model brings together paying customers, volunteers and people experiencing financial hardship around a shared dining experience.Guests who can afford to pay are encouraged to make a suggested donation and cover the cost of another person's meal. Those unable to contribute financially can volunteer their time, with restaurant staff helping them explore opportunities to participate in the community. The arrangement is not a conventional pay-what-you-want system, according to the organisation, but a structured effort to connect meals with volunteering and community support.The restaurant serves a chef-prepared three-course meal, typically including soup or salad, a choice of entree and dessert or fruit. Menus change every two weeks, and ingredients are sourced locally where possible. The restaurant says it aims to ensure that nutritious food is accessible without making the ability to pay a condition for being welcomed at the table.The restaurant's work extends beyond providing meals. It collaborates with local organisations to connect guests with resources related to housing, mental health, substance-use support, employment and other essential needs.In a May 22, 2026, feature, the James Beard Foundation described how the restaurant uses food as an entry point for building relationships with people facing difficulties that may not be immediately visible. Founder and programme director Dorothea Bongiovi explained that creating a safe and welcoming environment can help guests feel comfortable discussing their circumstances and seeking assistance.The foundation's feature reported that 78% of diners across the restaurant's operations identified as being in need. It also described how community coordinators work with partner organisations in Monmouth and Ocean counties to connect guests with relevant services. These can include housing assistance, job training, addiction treatment, mental health support and help accessing public benefits.The 78% figure refers to diners identifying as being in need across the restaurant's operations, while the foundation's separate first-half-of-2026 statement specifically reports that more than 80% of meals at the Toms River location went to guests experiencing food insecurity.The restaurant's impact in Ocean County was also evident at a temporary JBJ Soul Kitchen pop-up inside the Ocean County Library in downtown Toms River. Launched in February 2025 at the library's invitation, the initiative aimed to respond to the growing needs of people experiencing homelessness and expand access to meals and community support during the winter Code Blue season.The pop-up closed on April 30, 2026. Before closing, it had served more than 15,870 meals over the previous year, with 79% going to guests in need, according to JBJ Soul Kitchen. More than 1,000 volunteers contributed nearly 4,000 hours of service during the initiative.The programme also connected guests with support beyond food. According to the organisation, it distributed more than 1,350 hygiene kits and made 276 referrals to service providers. These efforts resulted in 13 successful housing placements and nine people securing employment. The figures were also reported by News 12 New Jersey in April 2026.Although the library pop-up has closed, the organisation confirmed that its permanent Toms River restaurant on Hooper Avenue would continue operating. The temporary site's results demonstrate how the same pay-it-forward approach can be extended to meet needs in a specific community, particularly when food insecurity overlaps with homelessness and limited access to essential services.JBJ Soul Kitchen's approach aims to make food assistance part of an ordinary restaurant experience. Rather than separating people who need help from those who can pay, the model encourages them to share the same space and meal.The Jon Bon Jovi Soul Foundation received the 2026 James Beard Foundation Impact Award, recognising its work addressing hunger, poverty and homelessness. The award brought wider attention to the organisation's community-based approach and the role its restaurants play in connecting people with both meals and support services.
Article Summary: More than 80% of meals served at JBJ Soul Kitchen in Toms River, New Jersey, went to guests experiencing food insecurity during the first half of 2026. The Jon Bon Jovi Soul Foundation's community restaurant does not list fixed prices on its menu. Instead, diners who can afford their meals are encouraged to make a suggested donation and contribute towards the cost of feeding someone else. Guests unable to pay are welcomed to enjoy a meal and learn about volunteering opportunities.

Article Title: Meet homeless man Anders Fernstedt, who has lived outside London’s £210 million mansion for 3.5 years; how he survives without money, sleeps through winters and why neighbours let him stay
Article Text:
Anders Fernstedt has lived outside a £210 million mansion in London’s Knightsbridge for three and a half years. (Photo: DW Euromaxx)

How Anders Fernstedt ended up homeless

How he built a home outside a £210 million mansion

The 45-room mansion at Rutland Gate reportedly sold for £210 million in 2020 but remains unoccupied. (Photo: DW Euromaxx)

Why the neighbours let him stay

Anders Fernstedt relies on donated food, clothes and charitable services to meet his everyday needs. (Photo: DW Euromaxx)

How he manages without money, electricity or basic amenities

The homeless man uses portable power banks to keep his phone running and download books. (Photo: DW Euromaxx)

Why he says he finally feels at home

Anders Fernstedt says friendly conversations and small gestures from neighbours have helped him feel more secure. (Photo: DW Euromaxx)

A homeless man has been living outside one of London’s most expensive mansions for three and a half years, building an unusual home in one of the British capital’s wealthiest neighbourhoods. While the sprawling 45-room property remains empty, Anders Fernstedt has created a life for himself outside it, relying on donated food, clothes, books and a makeshift shelter.Located in Knightsbridge, the mansion at 2 to 8A Rutland Gate reportedly sold for £210 million in 2020. The property boasts views of Hyde Park, marble bathrooms, 116 windows and an indoor swimming pool. However, the buyer never moved in, leaving the luxurious property unoccupied for years.Fernstedt’s unusual living arrangement was explored in a video feature by DW Euromaxx, which followed him to understand how he ended up living outside the luxury property, how he manages without money and why some neighbours have accepted his presence.Fernstedt was raised by his mother in Sweden and later pursued several careers in Sweden and the United States, establishing himself in the technology sector. He moved to England in 2016 and worked as a journalist and fact-checker before work dried up around the Covid-19 pandemic.A share in a technology company from his time in the US provided him with savings that he relied on for several years. However, as freelance commissions became harder to secure, his money gradually ran out.“There was enough money for me to live off for a few years, but only frugally, half the time in a tent,” he explained.Fernstedt said he slowly became accustomed to living on less, to the point that he did not immediately realise when he had effectively run out of money.“I slowly got used to frugality that I didn't even notice when I stopped having money,” he said.Fernstedt initially thought the spot outside the mansion would provide shelter for a night. Instead, it became his home for years.An avid camper with an interest in nature, he has adapted his outdoor space to suit his needs. He compares his makeshift shelter to a Mongolian yurt or other traditional tents, describing the imaginative way he has created a home on the mansion’s porch.He has also accumulated belongings that help him feel secure and comfortable. Comparing his collection to a squirrel storing nuts, Fernstedt explained that having several supplies means he does not immediately notice when something goes missing.His sleeping arrangements are particularly important to him. He has built up a collection of duvets and bedding, including what he described as seven layers of Hungarian down.“I haven't had a bad night's sleep for as long as I can remember,” he said, adding that his arrangements help him sleep through all four seasons.Fernstedt has learned to adapt to outdoor living, including London’s winters. He explained that sleeping without walls can also allow air to circulate during warmer weather.Living outside a mansion in one of London’s most exclusive neighbourhoods might appear difficult, but Fernstedt says he has gradually developed relationships with people in the surrounding community.After spending a few weeks at the location, he realised that residents knew he was there. He began thinking about how to make his presence familiar without intruding on their lives.He said he believed the neighbourhood’s children and grandchildren could help make his case to their families, hoping that conversations at home would encourage residents to accept him.Over time, some neighbours began approaching him to ask whether he needed anything. Their gestures have included food, clothes and even an elegant Italian dinner jacket.Fernstedt said that beyond material donations, he values ordinary human interaction and friendly conversations with the people living nearby.Not everyone in the neighbourhood has welcomed his presence, but he has found support from residents who appreciate his efforts to keep his makeshift home tidy and his lifestyle quiet. Some reportedly believe his presence may also help deter thieves or vandals from targeting the empty property.The feature does not establish that Fernstedt has formal permission or a legal right to remain outside the mansion.Fernstedt describes himself as being almost completely disconnected from money. His daily expenses are minimal, with filter coffee among the few things he says he pays for.For essentials such as showers, food and clothing, he relies partly on charitable support. He visits a charity near Victoria that provides showers, a canteen and access to donated clothing and other basic necessities.The support helps him obtain everyday items, including socks, while occasional gifts from neighbours offer additional assistance.Without a conventional electricity supply, Fernstedt relies on several portable power banks to keep his devices running. He uses his phone to download books, including history titles and the diaries of filmmaker Andrei Tarkovsky.His collection of books and personal belongings offers a sense of continuity in a life that otherwise operates far removed from conventional housing and employment.Fernstedt’s current arrangement has given him a sense of security that he says he did not always experience in temporary accommodation.After living at the location for years, he no longer constantly worries that his belongings will disappear while he is away.“Because I've been here so long, I'm free of worrying now, and if we worry too much, we won't be happy,” he said.
Article Summary: Anders Fernstedt has lived outside a £210 million mansion for three and a half years. He relies on donated food, clothes, books and a makeshift shelter. The 45-room mansion at Rutland Gate reportedly sold for £210m in 2020. The buyer never moved in, leaving the luxurious property unoccupied for years.

Article Title: Nominee vs legal heir: What is the difference and who has claim on assets? All you need to know
Article Text:

Who is a Legal Heir?

Difference between a Nominee and a Legal heir

Aspect Nominee Legal Heir Role Custodian Owner Transfer of Assets Can be done without any legal formalities. Requires testamentary documents for proof of ownership. Powers No power to transact, use, or transfer assets. Power to use and transact assets as an owner. Appointment Owner can appoint anyone, but some institutions specify certain conditions. Determined by succession/personal laws. Legal Right Cannot contest ownership legally. Can contest ownership in a court of law.

When individuals open bank accounts, invest in mutual funds, or buy insurance, they are often asked to name a nominee.However, many people mistakenly assume that the nominee automatically inherits the assets. In reality, the nominee is not always the final recipient — the ownership rights belong to the legal heir, reported ET.Understanding the distinction between these two is essential to ensure that your wealth is passed on to the intended beneficiaries.A nominee acts as a temporary custodian of the deceased person’s assets.The nominee’s role is limited to holding and managing the assets until they are legally transferred to the rightful heirs.According to ET, the nominee cannot sell, trade, or make any transactional decisions about the assets.The account or policy owner can appoint anyone — family, friends, or acquaintances — as a nominee, though financial institutions often prefer close family members.In some cases, the nominee and the legal heir can be the same person, which helps in ensuring a smoother transfer of assets.The legal heir or beneficiary is the rightful owner of the assets once the original holder passes away.To claim ownership, the legal heir must produce valid documents such as a will or other testamentary proof.If there is no will — a situation known as dying intestate — the heir is determined as per the country’s succession or personal laws, reported ET.While a nominee can initially access the assets, only the legal heir can claim them permanently or challenge ownership in court.Experts quoted by ET emphasise that having clarity on this difference helps avoid disputes and ensures that the savings reach the intended family members or beneficiaries.Therefore, it is advisable to regularly update both nominees and wills to align with one’s estate planning goals.
Article Summary: A nominee acts as a temporary custodian of the deceased person’s assets. The legal heir or beneficiary is the rightful owner of the assets once the original holder passes away. To claim ownership, the legal heir must produce valid documents such as a will.

How Jeevan Pramaan simplifies pensioner verification



Every year, lakhs of pensioners across India must prove that they are still alive to continue receiving their pension. This verification, known as the Life Certificate or Digital Life Certificate (DLC), is a crucial and mandatory step in ensuring that pension payments are made only to eligible recipients, preventing fraud and misuse.Traditionally, this process involved visiting the bank or pension office in person, standing in long queues, and submitting a signed paper certificate. However, with the government’s focus on digitisation and technological advancement, this process has become much simpler, faster, and more convenient. Pensioners can now submit their certificates digitally from the comfort of their homes using Jeevan Pramaan, a secure, user-friendly, and Aadhaar-based platform.A Life Certificate is an official document that confirms a pensioner is alive. Without it, pension payments are automatically paused by the pension disbursing agency. This verification is essential for preventing fraudulent claims and ensuring that pensions reach the rightful beneficiaries.The Digital Life Certificate (DLC), also known as Jeevan Pramaan, is an advanced biometric-enabled version of the traditional paper certificate.Introduced by the Government of India, it uses Aadhaar-based biometric authentication using either fingerprint or iris scan to verify a pensioner’s identity. Once verified, a digital certificate is automatically generated and shared with authorised pension disbursing agencies.This online process eliminates the need for physical verification, providing elderly pensioners with a simpler and more accessible way to maintain their pension benefits.According to PIB, The submission of the Life Certificate is mandatory for all pensioners who wish to continue receiving their pension without interruption. For the year 2025, the standard submission period is betweenTo make the process more comfortable for the elderly, the government allows pensioners aged 80 years and above to begin the submission process earlier, from 1 October 2025. This extended window gives senior citizens more time and flexibility to complete the procedure without facing last-minute difficulties.The Jeevan Pramaan process involves two main steps: registering the biometric device and generating the digital certificate.Before using the service, pensioners or operators must register their biometric device such as a fingerprint or iris scanner. During registration, the user provides their Aadhaar number and mobile number, after which an OTP (One-Time Password) is sent to their mobile. After entering the OTP, they must provide their name and email ID before scanning their fingerprint or iris.Once authentication is complete, the system confirms that device registration was successful, allowing the user to move to the next step.In this step, the pensioner enters personal details such as Aadhaar number, mobile number, name, PPO number, pension type, sanctioning authority, disbursing agency, and bank account details. The system also asks whether the pensioner has remarried or is re-employed.After entering all details, the pensioner scans their fingerprint or iris using the registered biometric device. Upon successful authentication, the Digital Life Certificate is generated, and an SMS acknowledgment with the Jeevan Pramaan Certificate ID is sent to the registered mobile number.This certificate is automatically stored in the Life Certificate Repository, accessible anytime to both pensioners and pension agencies.Once the Digital Life Certificate is created, it can be electronically delivered to the concerned Pension Disbursing Agency (PDA). PDAs can log in to the Jeevan Pramaan portal to view, verify, or download the certificate directly.Pensioners can also download a PDF copy of their certificate by visiting the Jeevan Pramaan website and entering their Pramaan ID or Aadhaar number. This ensures transparency and easy access for future reference.The government provides several options to submit the Life Certificate, allowing pensioners to choose the method that suits them best.Pensioners who prefer traditional methods can visit their bank branch or a Citizen Service Centre (CSC) to submit their Life Certificate physically. Trained staff at these centres assist pensioners in verifying their details and completing the process.For those unable to travel due to age or health issues, India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) offers a doorstep banking service. Pensioners can schedule an appointment, and an IPPB representative will visit their home to complete the submission using biometric authentication. This service is available for both IPPB and non-IPPB account holders.For pensioners comfortable with technology, the Jeevan Pramaan portal provides a completely online process. By visiting https://jeevanpramaan.gov.in, pensioners can submit their Digital Life Certificate using a computer, laptop, or smartphone equipped with a fingerprint or iris scanner.The system uses the Aadhaar platform to authenticate biometric details. Once verification is successful, a Digital Life Certificate is generated and stored in a secure online repository. Pension disbursing agencies can then directly access the certificate, removing the need for physical paperwork.The UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) app offers another easy option. Pensioners can download the app from the Google Play Store, search for “Jeevan Pramaan,” and select “Generate Life Certificate.”After entering the necessary details such as Aadhaar number, PPO number, and type of pension, pensioners must authenticate themselves using biometric verification. The app then generates a Digital Life Certificate (DLC), which is automatically shared with the pension disbursing authority.All pensioners who receive government, defence, or private sector pensions through authorised disbursing agencies are required to submit their Life Certificate every year. This includes:Failure to submit the certificate within the stipulated period may result in temporary suspension of pension payments until verification is completed.To ensure a smooth submission process, pensioners should keep certain details and documents ready. These include:Having these details ready helps to avoid delays or errors during authentication, whether submitting online or offline.Yes, an Aadhaar number or Virtual ID (VID) is mandatory to generate a Digital Life Certificate. The entire Jeevan Pramaan system is based on Aadhaar authentication, which ensures accuracy and prevents fraud. Pensioners must make sure their Aadhaar is linked with their mobile number and bank account before attempting to generate the certificate.The Digital Life Certificate is fully valid and legally recognised under the Information Technology Act. Pension disbursing authorities across India accept it as an official document, equivalent to the traditional paper-based life certificate.Its biometric verification system makes it secure and tamper-proof, reducing the chances of wrongful pension disbursal or misuse of pension funds.Before the introduction of Jeevan Pramaan, pensioners often faced difficulties in submitting their certificates, especially those with health problems or limited mobility. The digital system has removed these challenges, allowing pensioners to submit their verification anytime and anywhere.By integrating biometric technology and Aadhaar authentication, Jeevan Pramaan has streamlined pension management, improving efficiency for both pensioners and government departments. It also enhances transparency and ensures that genuine beneficiaries receive payments on time.
Article Summary: A Life Certificate is an official document that confirms a pensioner is alive. Without it, pension payments are automatically paused by the pension disbursing agency. This verification is essential for preventing fraudulent claims and ensuring that pensions reach the rightful beneficiaries. The Digital Life Certificate (DLC), also known as Jeevan Pramaan, is an advanced biometric- enabled version of the traditional paper certificate.

Article Title: How to get your CIBIL credit score without a PAN card
Article Text:
Your credit score is a three-digit number that reflects your creditworthiness and repayment capacity.

What is a CIBIL score?

How to get your CIBIL Credit score without a PAN Card

Factors affecting your CIBIL score

CIBIL credit score : Understanding your creditworthiness is pivotal in today's financial landscape, especially when seeking loans or credit cards. The Credit Information Bureau (India) Limited, commonly known as CIBIL, plays an important role in this regard by providing credit scores to borrowers.According to ET, credit score helps banks make informed decisions about extending credit cards and loans. Your credit history influences your CIBIL score , which is calculated using a special method.Your CIBIL score is a three-digit number that reflects your creditworthiness and repayment capacity. Ranging from 300 to 900, a higher score indicates a stronger likelihood of loan approval. Banks and financial institutions use this score to assess the risk associated with lending money.1. Go to the official CIBIL website and click on 'Personal CIBIL score,' then 'Get Your Free CIBIL score.' Follow the link provided and fill in all the required details.2. If you don’t have a PAN Card, you can use an alternative identification such as Passport, Voter ID, Driver’s License, or Ration Card. Enter the number of the chosen ID.3. Provide your date of birth, PIN code, and select your state. Finally, enter your mobile number and click on ‘Accept and Continue’.4. Authenticate your identity by entering the OTP (One-Time Password) delivered to your mobile device on the next screen. Click 'Continue' to proceed.5. Choose whether you want to link the device with your account. Select 'Yes' or 'No' based on your preference.6. Upon successful registration, you will see a page confirming that 'You have successfully registered!'7. Click on ‘Go to Dashboard’ to access and view your CIBIL score.The factors influencing the new CIBIL score, as stated on the CIBIL website, include:1. Depth of credit: This refers to the duration of your existing credit history, calculated from the opening date of your oldest credit account.2. Long-term trend of outstanding balances: The overall trend of outstanding balances over time affects your score.3. Transaction history on credit cards: How you manage transactions on your credit cards impacts your score.4. Ratio of actual repayment amount to total amount due: This ratio indicates your repayment behavior and influences your score accordingly.5. Number of new accounts opened and number of accounts closed: Opening or closing accounts can affect your score, so managing these actions wisely is important.

Article Title: Instagram tests 90-minute horizontal videos - what it means for long-form content creators

Instagram on Monday began testing new features, including 90-minute horizontal videos to target long-form content creators like podcasters and comedians, with select creators in the US.The feature, called “Features”, will allow them to link short reel clips, typically around three minutes or less, to full-length videos, as per The Hollywood Reporter.“What you’re now going to be able to do is, you see a clip of a podcast that you love, you can just click and continue watching or watch the full video, and you’ll be able to dive in and see the whole thing because creators are going to be able to link these Reels to their overall feature,” vice-president of product at Instagram, Tessa Lyons, said.Instagram has already been testing Features with creators in Brazil and plans to expand the trial to tens of thousands of creators in the US. The videos will reportedly be recommended to users through the Explore page and other areas of the platform.The feature will be available on mobile, with Instagram aiming to extend the viewing experience to its TV app. Instagram for TV, which launched last year and is available on Samsung , Fire TV and Google TV, is now expanding to Apple TV in the US.“We think the best viewing experience for longform horizontal content is on a big, horizontal screen, and so I think that is where we will expect a lot of the deep consumption to happen over time,” Lyons said, as per The Hollywood Reporter.Instagram is also experimenting with “Series”, a feature that gives episodic Reels a dedicated space on a creator’s profile. The move comes amid growing interest in microdramas and episodic videos among creators.In June, the company began reaching out to microdrama studios in Southeast Asia to test the feature. It has since approached individual creators who have been experimenting with episodic content.Instagram plans to begin testing Series in more countries in the coming months, with a US launch targeted for the end of this year or early next year. The company has also started testing how the feature will appear on television.Other experiments include integrating live videos into the Reels tab and recommending them to users who do not follow the creators. The test is launching in Indonesia and Brazil, with an expansion to the US planned for next year.

Article Title: PHP security flaws trigger global scramble; CERT-In flags vulnerabilities
Article Text:
The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) issued a criticalseverity warning. (Reuters photo)

CERT-In Flags Vulnerabilities

BENGALURU: It has been a difficult day for cybersecurity, with critical vulnerabilities in PHP triggering an urgent global patching effort, millions of reported hacking attempts, and precautionary shutdowns of some online services. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said the scale of the incident was unusual, remarking at an event in Cologne in Germany that he had not seen anything like it “in a long, long time”.The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) issued a critical-severity warning over two vulnerabilities in PHP, a widely used open-source scripting language that powers websites and web applications. The flaws could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute malicious code remotely, disclose memory and potentially compromise affected systems.In its advisory issued on Wednesday, CERT-In said reports had confirmed large-scale exploitation in the wild and urged organisations and individuals using affected versions to apply security updates urgently.Google Cloud executives Chris Betz, chief information security officer, and Raluca Ada Popa, head of Gemini Security at Google DeepMind, said PHP and cybersecurity firm Wiz Research disclosed the two vulnerabilities after research that used multiple AI models to identify and help remediate them.Google Cloud said its own infrastructure was not vulnerable, but warned that customers running PHP applications on the platform could be exposed. It urged customers to update their applications to patched PHP versions and redeploy them. Google is also rolling out updated serverless base images for supported PHP runtimes, with automatic updates available for certain services and configurations.The scale of the response has extended beyond India. “In the 10 hours before it was publicly announced, across the network we saw thousands of attempts to exploit it,” Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince wrote in a post on X on Wednesday. Companies and govt agencies in several countries temporarily restricted access to some online services as a precaution while they worked to secure vulnerable systems.Cloudflare’s blog said it successfully deployed mitigations for all its customers after the PHP vulnerabilities were leaked before their official disclosure date. The company observed attack traffic targeting customers and tracked how attackers modified their payloads to try to bypass its security.
Article Summary: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) issued a critical-severity warning over two vulnerabilities in PHP. The flaws could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute malicious code remotely, disclose memory and potentially compromise affected systems. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said the scale of the incident was unusual.

Article Title: As Michael Dell thanks Jensen Huang ‘with a bunch of history’, Nvidia CEO calls him pride of …
Article Text:

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Dell Technologies founder Michael Dell recently engaged in a warm public exchange reflecting on the formative years of the personal computer industry. Both the executives traded nostalgic memories with Hunag highlighting Dell’s early beginnings and long-standing manufacturing ties with Taiwan. Praising the billionaire founder, Huang looked back on how the availability of Taiwanese PC hardware and chipsets opened the doors for entrepreneurial pioneers, singling out Dell as a defining success story and calling him the “pride of Austin.” Recalling how Dell got his start in the hardware business, Huang outlined how accessible components enabled a young college student to launch what would become a global tech powerhouse.“What started out as Compeq, IBM, because of Taiwan PC chipsets were available to all kinds of companies, including this little kid named Michael Dell. He just bought motherboards from Taiwan, assembled them into a PC, bought an operating system, licensed an operating system from Microsoft and he became a PC maker,” Huang said.Huang emphasised Dell's deep-rooted connection to the island's tech ecosystem, adding, “Michael has a relationship in Taiwan that goes way back.He's from Austin, Texas, pride of Austin, and he's a good guy. What a nice man. Great human being.”Acknowledging Huang's remarks, Michael Dell took to social media to thank the Nvidia CEO while sharing archival details of his earliest visits to Taiwan and the hardware behind his very first machines.“Thanks very much @JensenHuang! My first trip to Taiwan was in 1985 when I was 20,” Dell wrote, pointing out that Taiwanese printed circuit board manufacturer Compeq (not computer company Compaq) was instrumental in producing early components for his nascent operation.“Compeq (not Compaq 😂) made PCBs for us. This is the hand wired (Jay Bell, RIP) prototype of our first 286 based PC and the actual production motherboard,” Dell shared.Dell also pointed out how the global semiconductor landscape looked different prior to the rise of foundry giant Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC): “It was based on a chipset from Chips and Technologies, they were produced in Japan at that time before TSMCs rise. I explained a bunch of this history in #PlayNiceButWin.”

Article Title: Dell expands AI factory with NVIDIA, announces new agentic AI solutions and infrastructure
Article Text: Dell Technologies has unveiled a broad set of updates to its Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA, introducing new agentic AI solutions, deskside AI offerings, validated ecosystem integrations and purpose-built infrastructure aimed at helping enterprises move AI projects from experimentation to production. The company said more than 6,500 customers have now adopted the platform, up from 5,000 in the previous quarter.The announcement comes as enterprises increasingly look to deploy agentic AI systems that can reason, make decisions and perform tasks autonomously. Dell said the latest expansion of its AI portfolio is designed to provide organisations with greater control over their AI infrastructure, data, models and operations while addressing concerns around costs, governance and return on investment.According to the company, the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA combines infrastructure, software, ecosystem partnerships and managed services to help businesses deploy AI workloads on infrastructure they own and control. The company argued that enterprises are prioritising end-to-end AI lifecycle support and are seeking alternatives to cloud-only deployments.As part of the update, Dell announced that Reflection's Beam open-weight model has been validated on the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA, giving enterprises access to an Apache 2.0-licensed model designed for software engineering and long-horizon agentic AI workloads.Dell also expanded its AI ecosystem through integrations with partners including Dynatrace for AI observability, Mistral for knowledge assistants and agentic AI platforms, and Fogsphere for computer vision applications. The company said the ecosystem now spans AI models, applications and operating systems, including support for SUSE Linux.The company additionally highlighted a multilayered security architecture that combines hardware-rooted infrastructure, NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture and Red Hat AI Factory software to help enterprises securely deploy autonomous AI agents at scale.Dell also expanded its Dell Deskside Agentic AI portfolio with new validated deployment templates designed to help businesses scale AI workloads from a single developer workstation to deployments of more than 1,000 systems. The new solutions include blueprints for agentic coding, AI-powered workflows, NVIDIA NemoClaw deployments, Hermes Agent implementations and higher-education AI lab environments.On the hardware front, Dell announced a new 64GB unified-memory configuration of the Dell Pro Precision with GB10, aimed at developers and smaller teams working on local AI development projects. The company said systems can be clustered together to support larger AI models and more complex workflows. Dell also disclosed that the Dell Pro Precision with GB300 workstation will soon be available with Windows support, delivering up to 748GB of coherent memory and up to 20 petaflops of FP4 compute performance.To support growing AI workloads, Dell introduced several new infrastructure offerings.Among them is the Dell Modular Data Center with NVIDIA DSX POD, a containerised, factory-integrated AI infrastructure design that includes compute, storage, networking, power and liquid cooling systems aimed at accelerating AI deployments.The company also announced the Dell PowerEdge M9882, a server platform featuring 256 NVIDIA Vera CPUs in a single rack designed for agent orchestration, code execution and other AI execution workloads. For mainstream enterprise environments, Dell introduced the Dell PowerEdge R8822, an air-cooled server optimised for agentic AI workloads, data processing, analytics and reinforcement learning.Another addition is the Dell PowerEdge XE9810, which Dell said will provide rack-scale inference capabilities using Groq 3 Language Processing Units for high-throughput production AI deployments. The company also unveiled new NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer (ARC) platforms running on Dell PowerEdge servers, targeting telecom operators that want to run radio access network and AI workloads on a shared infrastructure.

Article Title: Apple Pro and tell event: Touchscreen MacBook Pro, M6 iMac, OLED iPad mini and more expected
Article Text:
Apple is expected to unveil its first touchscreen MacBook Pro at the Pro and tell event on October 28.

The touchscreen MacBook Pro brings OLED and the Dynamic Island to the Mac

M6 iMac and OLED iPad mini are expected after a two-year wait

Apple's Pro and tell event takes place in Los Angeles this Wednesday, October 28, at 10am Pacific time, or 10:30pm IST. The company hasn't confirmed what it will show, but Bloomberg's Mark Gurman expects a busy day of Mac and iPad news. Headlining the list is Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro. It will be joined by an M6 version of the entry-level MacBook Pro, an M6 iMac and an iPad mini with an OLED display.Marketing chief Greg Joswiak teased the announcements on October 19 with a short "Can't wait to pro and tell next week" post. This is Apple's second event this month. It comes two weeks after the Welcome Home showcase in New York, where the company introduced the HomeView smart display, the HomePod mini 2 and a new Apple TV 4K.Writing in his Power On newsletter, Gurman says the higher-end MacBook Pro will come in 14-inch and 16-inch sizes with an OLED touchscreen, a first on both counts for the Mac. The laptop looks similar to current models but weighs less, adds the iPhone's Dynamic Island and runs on M5 Pro and M5 Max chips. It is also expected to cost significantly more than today's top MacBook Pros.Touch will be an extra option, with the keyboard and trackpad staying central.Apple is tweaking macOS Golden Gate so that it presents controls based on whether someone has been tapping the screen or using the trackpad. Tapping a button can bring up a menu around the finger, and the Dock and Menu Bar have been reworked for touch. Gurman has said on his podcast that the laptop could go on sale on November 6.It is quite a reversal for a company whose co-founder Steve Jobs called touchscreen laptops "ergonomically terrible" back in 2010.The regular 14-inch MacBook Pro will keep its current design but move from the M5 to the M6 chip, which arrived with the Mac mini in August. Reports suggest it could pick up a hole-punch camera, along with a price increase as component shortages ripple across Apple's lineup. Gurman says a redesigned version of this model is planned for next year.The iMac is set to jump straight from the M4 to the M6, nearly two years after its last refresh. Little else is expected to change, though new colour options are possible.The iPad mini, meanwhile, could become the first iPad outside the Pro line to switch to OLED. It is expected to move to the A20 chip from the iPhone 18, and the new screen may push its price up.Apple's Mac lineup will be crowded after Wednesday, stretching from the MacBook Neo and MacBook Air to three kinds of MacBook Pro. Gurman says OLED versions of the MacBook Air and iMac are already in testing, though neither is imminent. A refreshed non-OLED MacBook Air is due early next year.
Article Summary: M6 iMac and OLED iPad mini are expected after a two-year wait. Apple's Pro and tell event takes place in Los Angeles this Wednesday, October 28, at 10am Pacific time, or 10:30pm IST. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman expects a busy day of Mac and iPad news.

Article Title: What are Neocloud providers that Elon Musk has predicted are going to see ‘guppy-level death’
Article Text:
Image credit: Cisco

“SpaceX closed $40B of debt for GPUs, but we’re investment grade and have Starlink & launch revenue.

That means the 200+ neoclouds are going to see guppy-level death and consolidation.

Some will make it through, but not many.”

“As of the past few weeks, debt markets have almost entirely shut off access to money for any company that doesn’t have substantial revenue independent of AI data centers,”

What are Neoclouds

Benefits of neoclouds

Are there any limitations too

Narrower service portfolios: Hyperscale providers offer extensive managed services, including serverless functions, managed databases, analytics platforms, and global content delivery. Neoclouds typically focus on infrastructure-level AI services rather than full application ecosystems. This makes them less versatile for wider, all-encompassing applications.

Geographic footprint: Many neocloud providers operate in fewer regions compared to global hyperscalers. Organisations with strict data residency requirements must carefully evaluate availability.

Operational maturity: Teams accustomed to platform-as-a-service models may need additional expertise to manage lower-level infrastructure constructs such as network topology awareness or distributed training optimisation.

Integration complexity: Hybrid architectures that combine neocloud AI clusters with traditional IT systems require secure connectivity, policy alignment, and careful workload placement decisions.

Why specific neocloud weaknesses could turn into failures

Narrow service range: Neoclouds mostly sell AI infrastructure, not full application ecosystems. That leaves them dependent on AI-workload revenue, which is the profile Musk says lenders are avoiding.

Fewer regions: Many operate in fewer locations than hyperscalers. Customers with strict data residency rules may have to look elsewhere, which shrinks the pool of buyers.

Operational maturity: Teams used to managed platforms may need extra expertise to run lower-level infrastructure. That can slow adoption among firms that want simplicity.

Integration complexity: Linking neocloud clusters with existing IT systems needs secure connectivity, policy alignment and careful workload placement. Smaller firms with thinner resources may struggle to support this.
Article Summary: Neoclouds typically focus on infrastructure-level AI services rather than full application ecosystems. This makes them less versatile for wider, all- encompassing applications. Many neocloud providers operate in fewer regions compared to global hyperscalers.

Article Title: Stuffcool launches Giga Pro Max power bank with 100W fast charging
Article Text: Indian accessories brand Stuffcool has expanded its power bank lineup with the launch of the Giga Pro Max, a 20,000mAh portable charger designed for users who need to charge laptops, smartphones and other devices simultaneously. The new power bank combines a high-capacity battery, support for up to 100W fast charging and a built-in retractable USB-C cable, eliminating the need to carry an additional charging cable. According to the company, the device is aimed at professionals, students, travellers and users who regularly carry multiple gadgets.One of the key highlights of the Giga Pro Max is its integrated retractable USB-C cable that can be pulled out when needed and tucked away inside the power bank after use. The company says the cable includes an E-marker chip and supports up to 100W output, making it suitable for charging compatible laptops, MacBooks and other USB-C devices. The built-in design is intended to reduce cable clutter and ensure users always have a charging cable available.The Giga Pro Max supports a maximum total output of 100W and can charge multiple devices at the same time. The integrated USB-C cable can deliver up to 65W, while the additional USB-C port can provide up to 35W.This allows users to charge a laptop through the built-in cable while simultaneously charging a smartphone or another device through the USB-C port.The power bank also supports multiple charging configurations, including 65W through the built-in cable alongside 18W output from the USB-A port. Users can also connect three devices simultaneously through the built-in USB-C cable, USB-C port and USB-A port.Unlike conventional power banks focused mainly on smartphones, Stuffcool says the Giga Pro Max is designed to handle higher-power devices such as laptops and tablets. The device supports PPS charging and Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0, making it compatible with a wide range of USB-C gadgets. The power bank houses a 20,000mAh battery rated at 77Wh and weighs approximately 407g. It measures 14.3 x 7.2 x 4.0 cm, making it relatively compact for a laptop-capable portable charger.The Giga Pro Max also features a built-in digital display that shows the remaining battery percentage, allowing users to monitor charge levels more accurately. Another notable feature is pass-through charging support, which enables users to charge connected devices while the power bank itself is being recharged.
Article Summary: The Giga Pro Max has a retractable USB-C cable that can be pulled out when needed and tucked away inside the power bank after use. The power bank houses a 20,000mAh battery rated at 77Wh and weighs approximately 407g. The device supports PPS charging and Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0.

Article Title: Google DeepMind builds 3D periodic table with Gemini 4 Argon: What is so different about it
Article Text:
What sets the 3D periodic table apart

Google DeepMind has revealed a way to demonstrate the capabilities of its latest artificial intelligence (AI) system: a full chemistry visualisation synched to music. Using its recently launched Gemini 4 Argon model, DeepMind generated an interactive, three-dimensional periodic table that choreographs its movements to the tempo and lyrics of Tom Lehrer’s classic 1959 song, “The Elements. ” As the fast-paced tune plays, the visualisation highlights each element in real time, displaying animated electron pathways, detailed atomic specifications, and individual light spectra.The video was shared by Google Deepmind and re-shared by Google CEO Sundar Pichai, saying, “Sound on!”. The video surfaced a week after Gemini 4 Argon’s official public debut. In an amusing nod noted by observers, a model bearing the name of the noble gas Argon was used to reconstruct the periodic table itself.Built by DeepMind’s Antigravity development platform, the project moves well past the familiar flat grid of atomic symbols found in standard chemistry textbooks. The demonstration coordinates multiple layers of data and rendering simultaneously:Each element is rendered with moving electron orbits rather than flat diagrams, and the interface presents comprehensive atomic specifications alongside the specific light emission spectra for each material.Moreover, the most technically demanding element of the demo is its timing. Lehrer’s track is famous for rattling off element names at breakneck speed. Gemini 4 Argon successfully synchronized the visual rendering, underlying scientific datasets, and audio playback to hit each vocal cue and musical beat precisely.“Gemini 4 Argon built a 3D periodic table synced to Tom Lehrer’s song, “The Elements.” Created in @Antigravity, it animates orbiting electrons, atomic data, and light spectra,” Google DeepMind said.The periodic table is not an official benchmark score, instead, it serves as a creative demonstration of how the model handles complex, multi-stage "agentic" instructions that require synthesizing scientific logic, graphic generation, and real-time audio synchronization.Gemini 4 Argon rolled out publicly on October 13, 2026, with Google DeepMind targeting the system at sophisticated operational workflows, including scientific exploration and large-scale software engineering.
Article Summary: Gemini 4 Argon model synched to Tom Lehrer’s classic 1959 song, “The Elements. ” As the fast-paced tune plays, the visualisation highlights each element in real time, displaying animated electron pathways, detailed atomic specifications, and individual light spectra.

Article Title: Explained: How YouTube watching experience is set to improve with next-gen streaming technology
Article Text:
YouTube

YouTube’s rapid open-codec shift

Unlocking multi-view and richer browser experiences

YouTube is about to enhance its video streaming experience with an upcoming move to next-generation video compression technology that promises sharper visual quality while consuming comparatively less internet bandwidth. Earlier this year, the Alliance for Open Media finalised the official specifications for the AV2 codec. Engineering projections indicate that AV2 is roughly 25% to 32% more efficient than its predecessor, AV1. In practical terms, this efficiency gain allows platforms to stream noticeably higher-definition video at existing bitrates, or maintain sharp, pristine image clarity at significantly lower bitrates, essentially cutting down total data consumption for viewers.While major streaming peers such as Netflix, Amazon, and Apple have remained silent regarding their deployment roadmaps, YouTube is moving ahead openly. According to a report by Android Authority, YouTube has confirmed plans to begin rolling out AV2 streaming as early as early 2027, targeting the web browser version of the platform first.YouTube has anchored its infrastructure around royalty-free, open-standard compression technologies.“YouTube champions open codecs that deliver the best quality video with the fewest playback interruptions. As of March 19, 2026, over 90% of YouTube’s catalog (weighted by watch time) is available in AV1. And we’re excited to begin streaming in AV2, which brings even better video quality to users and unlocks new multi-video capabilities. YouTube AV2 streams will be available for Web as soon as early 2027,” Des Keane, Engineering Director at YouTube was quoted as saying.The performance leap delivered by AV2 extends past standard video playback. Engineering leadership at Google Chrome notes that the compression gains will enable complex layout features inside internet browsers.Jim Bankoski, engineering vice president of Chrome, highlighted the broader potential of the standard:“We’re encouraged by the momentum around AV2, with partners like YouTube, Netflix, and Prime Video exploring the format and showing strong support for the technology. Beyond faster, higher-quality streaming, AV2 lays the groundwork for new browser experiences, from better multi-view video to higher-resolution, more efficient video conferencing.”The multi-video capability could allow sports fans or event viewers to watch several high-definition camera feeds simultaneously on a single monitor without exhausting system resources or network capacity.However, despite YouTube’s timeline, widespread adoption of AV2 across everyday consumer electronics will take time.Historical rollouts show that video codec adoption moves slowly through global supply chains. For comparison, the original AV1 standard was finalised back in 2018, yet commercial smartphones featuring dedicated AV1 hardware encoding did not arrive on the market until the launch of the Google Pixel 10.
Article Summary: Next-generation video compression technology promises sharper visual quality. Engineering projections indicate that AV2 is roughly 25% to 32% more efficient than its predecessor, AV1. YouTube has confirmed plans to begin rolling out AV2 streaming as early as early 2027, targeting the web browser version of the platform first.

Article Title: Google Brain cofounder and AI pioneer Andrew Ng tells ‘one of the most disgusting things’ he has seen that AI is being used for
Article Text:
‘Balancing AI’s value with dangerous harms’

Artificial intelligence (AI) pioneer and Google Brain co-founder Andrew Ng has spoken out against malicious applications of the technology, noting the generation of non-consensual deepfake intimate photos as one of the most troubling misuses of modern software he has encountered. Addressing the darker side of technological development in an interview on The Economist's "Inside Tech" podcast recently, the Al pioneer dismissed the notion that this technology presents an existential threat to society.Firstly, Ng delivered a strong critique of synthetic explicit content, calling on lawmakers to establish strict regulations and severe measures to eliminate the abuse entirely.“AI applications have problems. For example, one of the most disgusting things I've ever seen is AI being used to generate non-consensual, deepfake intimate imagery,” Ng said, adding, “That's all for the past laws put in place for harsh penalties to just get rid of that.”While acknowledging the severe harms enabled by certain AI deployments, Ng maintained that the broader technology remains enormously valuable. The primary challenge, he indicated, is addressing harmful cases while preserving the societal benefits created by AI. Despite the prevalence of bad actors and misuse, Ng emphasised that he remains optimistic about the future of AI safety governance.“AI is tremendously valuable, but has some problematic use cases.The thing that gives me optimism is that many nations have managed to collaborate on safety issues, even when they disagreed on other things,” he said.To illustrate how the global community can manage safety risks, Ng pointed to commercial aviation as a proven precedent for cross-border collaboration.“For example, airlines around the world actually do not compete on safety and will share safety information because having aviation be safer is a good thing. Even if airlines are competing like crazy for business, I think there's actually room for collaboration,” Ng added.The founder of DeepLearning Al that provides technical training on Generative Al, Machine Learning, Deep Learning and other topics, also alleged some industry leaders of manufacturing existential safety arguments to lobby for regulations that crush open-source competition.
Article Summary: Google Brain co-founder Andrew Ng has spoken out against malicious applications of the technology. Ng noted the generation of non-consensual deepfake intimate photos as one of the most troubling misuses of modern software. The primary challenge, he indicated, is addressing harmful cases while preserving the societal benefits created by AI.

Article Title: Google CEO Sundar Pichai responds to Sam Altman’s ‘fend Google off’ remark, asks: ‘Are you bolting agents onto ChatGPT, or …’
Article Text:
Flipping the ‘Bolt-On’ question back to OpenAI

Pichai implies ‘winning means both adapting and building new’

Alphabet and Google CEO Sundar Pichai has pushed back against claims made by OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman , rejecting the notion that Google is merely retrofitting artificial intelligence (AI) into legacy products rather than developing authentic, AI-first systems. While acknowledging the tough competition, Pichai said that the company has been making AI systems and tools from ground up as well as refining products. The debate stems from comments by Altman regarding competition between the two tech powerhouses, where the OpenAI leader argued that his company builds AI-native applications while implying that Google simply “bolts” machine learning capabilities onto its existing software suite.“First of all, it’s a very dynamic moment. We are all pushing each other. OpenAI has pushed us as a company too. This is not just we are doing something to them. Far from it,” Pichai offered a candid response, emphasising that the intense technological race is driving innovation across the board.“In the AI moment, all of us have to respond with varying levels of urgency at any given moment in time,” he added.Pichai challenged the idea that Google lacks ground-up AI platforms, citing the direct development of the standalone Gemini app as evidence of ground-up product design.He then turned the exact same design critique back toward OpenAI, questioning how ChatGPT itself handles the rapid evolution toward autonomous software agents.“We are constantly building new products as well. Gemini was built from the ground up as a product—the Gemini app I’m talking about,” Pichai noted, asking, “Or tomorrow, as all of us are adapting to agents, are you bolting agents onto ChatGPT, or are they building it natively? How would you think about that? You can always flip these questions back.”Rather than getting trapped in industry labels over what qualifies as “native” versus “integrated,” Pichai explained that successfully navigating the generative AI shift requires deploying both strategies simultaneously. The ultimate goal, he argued, is to deliver standout user experiences that perform and win in the real world.“I don’t think of it that way. I think of it as you want to build world-class product experiences that are AI-native and they are winning. Some of it is adapting products, some of it is rethinking new experiences. They will all be part of how you approach this moment,” Pichai explained.
Article Summary: Pichai implies ‘winning means both adapting and building new’ Google CEO Sundar Pichai has pushed back against claims made by OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman. Altman argued that his company builds AI-native applications while implying that Google simply “bolts” machine learning capabilities onto existing software suite.

The car, powered by Porsche technology, marks the team's entry into the championship's GEN4 era. The new generation of Formula E cars can reach speeds of more than 335 km/h and accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in less than two seconds. They also feature permanent all-wheel drive.The car retains the team's signature copper colour scheme.ID@undefined Caption not available.British driver Jake Hughes will join the team for the new season.
